part_name: MJE15033 (PNP complementary silicon plastic power transistor, TO-220, 250 V / 8.0 A / 50 W)
product_page: NONE. onsemi has no product page for this part - see the lifecycle block below. This is a declared gap, not an omission.

license_notes: Manufacturer-distributed SPICE model, redistributed here unmodified for engineering traceability only. The file carries its own Symmetry Design Systems copyright notice, reproduced unaltered.
why_this_part: MJE15033 is the PNP half of the complementary Class A emitter follower that forms the output stage of the gain block (circuits/preamp/gain_block.py:368, FP_TO220). Same T7/T8 mandate as its NPN complement.

datasheet_is_frozen_elsewhere.why: onsemi publishes ONE datasheet for the complementary pair: its title line is 'MJE15032 (NPN), MJE15033 (PNP)' and its ordering table lists MJE15032G and MJE15033G together. December 2024 - Rev. 7, publication order number MJE15032/D. It is frozen once, under the part whose number the document bears, rather than as two byte-identical copies. There is no separate MJE15033 datasheet: https://www.onsemi.com/download/data-sheet/pdf/mje15033-d.pdf answers with the 303722-byte soft 404 (docs/limitations.md #18).

limits_read_with_their_conditions.note: Identical table to the NPN, since it is the same document. See vendor/bjt_npn/onsemi/MJE15032/PROVENANCE.json. The conditions that matter here are the same two traps: hFE is specified at 0.5/1.0/2.0 A and fT at 500 mA, while the design runs this device at 14.71 mA.

lifecycle.status: NOT CONFIRMED BY A PRODUCT PAGE. Orderable according to the manufacturer's own current datasheet. This gap is DECLARED rather than filled in.
lifecycle.what_was_tried_and_failed: onsemi has no product page for MJE15033. https://www.onsemi.com/products/discrete-power-modules/audio-transistors/mje15033 redirects to the category page (final URL '.../audio-transistors', 4238073 bytes); the slug with the G suffix and the bipolar-transistors category slug both redirect to category pages too; https://www.onsemi.com/api/search/products?q=MJE15033 answers 502; and https://www.onsemi.com/search/site/MJE15033 returns the homepage, not a result list. So the JSON-LD itemProductList reading that settled MJE15032 cannot be repeated here.
lifecycle.the_absence_is_specific_and_was_measured: The audio-transistors category page lists 49 parts by slug, including mje15028, mje15029, mje15030, mje15031, mje15032, mje15034 and mje15035 - but NOT mje15033. PNP siblings (15031, 15035) ARE listed, so the gap is not 'onsemi omits PNPs'.
lifecycle.evidence_that_it_is_nevertheless_orderab: Two independent manufacturer sources. (1) The current datasheet, December 2024 - Rev. 7, lists MJE15033G in ORDERING INFORMATION as TO-220 (Pb-Free), 50 Units/Rail, and the document contains ZERO occurrences of 'DISCONTINUED'; onsemi's convention for marking a dead OPN is known from the frozen 2N5551 datasheet, which carries both a page-1 banner and a 'DISCONTINUED (Note 6)' block. (2) The MJE15032 product page's own parametric comparison query names 'MJE15033G' alongside MJE15032G, MJE15030G, MJE15031G and MJE15029G.
lifecycle.honest_reading: A December-2024 datasheet that lists the OPN and does not mark it discontinued is strong evidence of an active part, and the vendor's marking convention makes the absence of a mark falsifiable. It is NOT the same class of evidence as the JSON-LD 'Active' that MJE15032G carries. The distinction is recorded because T8 says the lifecycle is read from the manufacturer, and here the manufacturer says it in a weaker way for this half of the pair than for the other.

spice_model.status: FOUND, served by the manufacturer, and PROVEN to load and run in ngspice.
spice_model.authorship_declared_in_the_file: Same MODPEX / Symmetry Design Systems / Interface Technologies header as the NPN, 'Model generated on Feb 1, 2004', 'Model format: PSpice'. Authored by a modelling contractor, distributed by the manufacturer - which is what ADR-016 freezes.
spice_model.no_flicker_noise: KF=0 and AF=1. No 1/f noise, same as its NPN complement. Relevant to NC-004.

datasheet_cross_check_L24.verdict: CONFORMING at all three published hFE points and at the published fT point. Unlike its NPN complement, which falls 5.1% short of the hFE minimum at 0.5 A.
datasheet_cross_check_L24.the_asymmetry_is_the_design_relevant_par: At the design's own 15 mA the two models give hFE 75.7 (NPN) and 129.3 (PNP) - a 1.7x mismatch inside a COMPLEMENTARY emitter follower. Base-current demand therefore differs by 1.7x between the two halves, which the placeholder pair (BF = 100 for both) could not show because it was symmetric by construction. This belongs to Fase 4, not to this lotto.
